sender: Sara Delgado, founder of One Day Trip Mexico City
offer: Curated, door-to-door day trips from Mexico City for international visitors, with executive transport and every detail handled.
looking_for: Haciendas, spas and craft workshops within a day trip of Mexico City that could host small groups of our guests.

criteria.name: niche_fit
criteria.description: Offers a design, craft, wellness or off-the-beaten-path experience that matches a curated audience.

criteria.name: international_ready

criteria.name: small_groups
criteria.description: Shows it can host private visits or small groups by reservation.

criteria.name: day_trip_access
criteria.description: Its location is stated and works as a round trip from Mexico City in one day.

criteria.name: easy_to_contact
criteria.description: Shows a direct contact route such as email, WhatsApp or a reservations team.
